skill.name: hmdb-database

skill.summary: Use HMDB metabolite data for metabolomics research and identification workflows.

content.value_statement: Metabolomics work often requires checking metabolite identity, spectra, pathways, and clinical context across many records. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through HMDB searches, downloads, and interpretation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides searches by metabolite name, synonym, HMDB identifier, structure, or biological specimen type.
Explains HMDB chemical, biological, clinical, pathway, and analytical data fields.
Supports workflows for metabolite identification, biomarker discovery, pathway review, and database integration.
Describes bulk download formats including XML, SDF, FASTA, TXT, CSV, and TSV.
Documents official HMDB access options and notes the lack of a public REST API.
limitations: It does not include a live HMDB API client or direct database connector.
It cannot guarantee that HMDB version details remain current after the source text date.
Commercial HMDB use may require permission from the database maintainers.
Metabolite identifications still need experimental validation and literature review.

use_cases.title: Identify Candidate Metabolites
use_cases.description: Match observed spectra, molecular weight, or structure details against HMDB fields and review likely candidates.

use_cases.title: Review Disease Biomarkers
use_cases.description: Find metabolites linked to diseases and compare normal or abnormal concentration ranges across biofluids.

use_cases.title: Plan Local Data Integration
use_cases.description: Choose HMDB download formats and fields for a local analysis database or pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Metabolite
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HMDB database skill to help me look up lactate. Summarize identifiers, formula, molecular weight, biofluids, and main pathway context.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Candidate Matches
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HMDB database skill to compare candidate metabolites for an observed mass of [mass]. Include search strategy, expected fields to inspect, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Biomarker Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HMDB database skill to review metabolites associated with [disease]. Focus on biofluid concentrations, citations, pathways, and limits of interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Design an HMDB Data Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the HMDB database skill to design a local HMDB integration workflow. Recommend download formats, key fields, version tracking, citation practices, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: Look up HMDB context for glucose.
output_examples.output: A concise metabolite brief with identifiers, chemical formula, molecular weight, common biofluids, pathway links, and recommended validation checks.

output_examples.input: Plan an HMDB download for pathway analysis.
output: Recommended XML for complete metabolite records.
Recommended CSV or TSV for tabular analysis.
A version tracking note and citation reminder.

output_examples.output: A structured comparison covering mass fit, spectra evidence, specimen plausibility, pathway context, and uncertainty.

best_practices: Use HMDB identifiers and database version details in research notes and publications.
Validate metabolite candidates with multiple evidence types, not a single spectral or mass match.
Use bulk downloads for large analyses instead of repeated manual web queries.
anti_patterns: Do not treat predicted spectra as equivalent to experimental confirmation.
Do not use HMDB concentration ranges without checking specimen type and context.
Do not rely on web scraping when proper downloads or approved access are available.

faq.question: Does this skill provide direct HMDB API access?
faq.answer: No. The source explains that HMDB does not provide a public REST API.

faq.question: Can it help with metabolite identification?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides searches by spectra, mass, structure, names, identifiers, and biological context.

faq.question: Can it support biomarker research?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains how to review disease associations, concentration ranges, and pathway context.

faq.question: Which HMDB file formats does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes XML, SDF, FASTA, TXT, CSV, and TSV downloads.

faq.question: Is commercial HMDB use covered?
faq.answer: The skill notes that commercial use requires explicit permission from HMDB contacts.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. HMDB results should be validated with experimental evidence, citations, and domain expertise.
